title: Community Library solution metadata
description: The metadata.yml every solution in solutions/<model>/<NNN>-<toolkit>-<method>/ includes. CONTRIBUTING.md explains each field. Fields beyond these are welcome; the HARK example records its software and numerical settings.

toolkit.description: The toolkit the solution uses, or the language and main libraries if it uses none, such as Julia (no toolkit).

method.description: A short name for the solution method, such as EGM, VFI or time iteration. The library table shows it.

project.description: The toolkit project the solution is submitted on behalf of, such as Econ-ARK. Leave it out for a solution submitted by individuals.

maintainers.description: The GitHub usernames of the people who maintain the solution and approve changes to it.

items.description: A GitHub username, such as akshayshanker, without the @.

model.description: The model's directory name, as in models/<model>/ and solutions/<model>/.

model_description_version.description: The version of the model description this solution follows, MAJOR.MINOR.

model_description.description: A link to that version of the model description, such as its tag.

ai_level.description: How much AI was involved in producing the text and code: 0 no AI, 1 AI-assisted editing, 2 AI-assisted drafting, 3 AI-drafted and human-directed, 4 AI-drafted with light human editing. Report the highest level that applies to any substantial part.

ai_used_for.description: What AI was used for, comma-separated, from: drafting, editing, code, derivation checks, literature, figures. Required when ai_level is above 0.

verified_by.description: The person who read the whole solution end to end and checked it against the model description. Leave the three verified_ fields out until someone has.

verified_date.description: The date of that verification, YYYY-MM-DD.

verified_version.description: The model description version the solution followed when it was verified. When it differs from model_description_version, the solution shows as not yet verified.
